snippet.title: Energetic Trailer [OFFICIAL]
snippet.description:
Energetic by Thomas Grip,  Jens Nilsson and Nicklas Mattisson, who later went on to form Frictional Games.

This was a university project for the LTH School of Engineering.
I found this game on an old archive.
I will be posting complete gameplay and OSTs later.
